question_text: In a government procurement, the ratio of office chairs to tables is 5:2. If there are 35 chairs, how many tables are there?

hint_ladder.title: Orient Yourself
hint_ladder.text: This is a ratio problem. Ratio 5:2 means 5 chairs per 2 tables. You have 35 chairs, so find tables keeping the same 5:2 relationship.

hint_ladder.title: The Simple Rule
hint_ladder.text: Find value of one part first. Divide the known quantity (35 chairs) by its ratio number (5). That gives value of one part.

hint_ladder.title: Apply the Rule
hint_ladder.text: One part = 35 ÷ 5 = 7. Tables get 2 parts, so multiply 7 by 2 to get tables.

hint_ladder.title: Almost There
hint_ladder.text: One part is 7, tables are 2 parts, so tables = 2 × 7 = ? The answer is the result.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you thought 2/7 of 35 = 10, but 35 is not the total—it's just the 5 parts for chairs.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you miscalculated, but 35 ÷ 5 = 7 and 2 × 7 = 14, not 12.

C.text: Correct. One part = 35 ÷ 5 = 7; tables are 2 parts, so 2 × 7 = 14. Ratio 35:14 = 5:2.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you miscalculated, but 35 ÷ 5 = 7 and 2 × 7 = 14, not 16.

next_time_rule: Always divide known quantity by its ratio number to find one part, then multiply by the other ratio number. Never treat known quantity as total unless stated.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mong si Kapitan ng inyong barangay ay bumili ng upuan at mesa para sa bagong barangay hall. Ang ratio ng chairs sa tables ay 5:2 — sa bawat limang upuan, may dalawang mesa. May 35 upuan na dumating. Ilang mesa?

Ang ratio 5:2 ay nangangahulugang 'parts' — 5 parts para sa upuan, 2 parts para sa mesa. Dahil 35 upuan = 5 parts, isang part ay 35 ÷ 5 = 7. Kaya bawat part sa ratio ay 7 aktwal na items.

Para sa mesa: 2 parts × 7 = 14. Kaya 14 na mesa ang kailangan. Check: 35 upuan at 14 mesa, i-divide pareho sa 7, makukuha mong 5:2 ulit. Simple, 'di ba?

Mental Trick: 'Divide mo lang yung known quantity sa sarili nitong ratio number, tapos multiply sa kabila.' Parang sinasabi, 'Bahagi ng akin, paramihin sa iyo.' Ugaling gamitin ito.

**Watch-Out Zone: fraction_of_total_misapplication** in action. 35 is chairs only, not ...
